messages:
marie (People Ops): Heads up — mandatory Privacy & Data Handling refresher + team attestations open today. Deadline in 14 days: Fri May 9 2025 23:59 PT. Everyone must finish the SecureLearn 'Privacy 2025' module. Managers: upload a team evidence bundle to the Drive link below. :calendar:

marie (People Ops): Links: Training: https://securelearn.example.com/courses/privacy-2025 | Attestation form: https://forms.example.com/redwood/privacy-attestation-2025 | Upload: https://drive.example.com/redwood/compliance/2025-privacy-evidence

marie (People Ops): Quick evidence checklist by org:
- Eng: dataflow diagram, retention config snippet, one sample query + access notes.
- Platform/SRE: log retention policy, S3 lifecycle, redacted audit samples.
- Sales/CS: redacted contract, signed DPA, consent templates.
- Product/Design: consent UI copy, tracking minimization notes.

sahil (InfoSec): Redaction note: keep timestamps/action codes; redact user IDs. See redaction playbook: https://confluence.example.com/display/SEC/Redaction+Playbook

jordan (Eng Manager): What about people on approved LOA?

marie (People Ops): They have 30 days after return to complete. Managers, mark exceptions in the attestation form.

alexa (Platform Eng): Do we need full runbooks or just PII sections? We have a migration in flight.

marie (People Ops): Include only sections touching PII + README explaining any pending changes and ETA. Pointers + excerpts are fine.

tom (Legal): Use Legal's contract-redaction template (linked in the form). Reach out if you need redaction help.

devops-bot: Reminder set 1: automated follow-up will post in #people-ops in 7 days and on final day.

marie (People Ops): Managers: submit attestation and upload by deadline. DM me for a 15-min walkthrough if helpful. :thumbsup:
